sql: with o as (select lo.id, lo.kalshi_order_id, lo.market_ticker, lo.created_at from live_orders lo where lo.strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and lo.side='no' and lo.action='buy' and lo.status='filled' and lo.limit_price between 90 and 95 and lo.created_at >= '2026-08-20'), f as (select fl.kalshi_order_id, min(fl.filled_at) as filled_at from fills fl where fl.filled_at >= '2026-08-20' and fl.kalshi_order_id in (select kalshi_order_id from o) group by 1), q0 as (select distinct on (live_order_id) live_order_id, contracts_ahead from live_order_queue_ticks where captured_at >= '2026-08-20' and live_order_id in (select id from o) order by live_order_id, captured_at), m as (select o.market_ticker, min(extract(epoch from (f.filled_at - coalesce(c.submitted_at,o.created_at)))/60.0) as wait_min, min(c.spread) as spread, min(q0.contracts_ahead) as ahead0 from o join f on f.kalshi_order_id=o.kalshi_order_id left join execution_order_context c on c.live_order_id=o.id left join q0 on q0.live_order_id=o.id group by 1), p as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, realized_pnl, coalesce(quantity_fp,quantity) as pos from positions where captured_at >= '2026-08-20' and market_ticker in (select market_ticker from m) order by market_ticker, captured_at desc) select 'wait' as dim, case when wait_min<5 then 'a <5m' when wait_min<30 then 'b 5-30m' when wait_min<120 then 'c 30-120m' else 'd 2h+' end as bucket, count(*) as mkts, sum((p.realized_pnl<0)::int) as losers from m join p using (market_ticker) where p.pos=0 group by 1,2 union all select 'ahead0', case when ahead0 is null then 'z ?' when ahead0<=10 then 'a 0-10' when ahead0<=100 then 'b 11-100' else 'c 100+' end, count(*), sum((p.realized_pnl<0)::int) from m join p using (market_ticker) where p.pos=0 group by 1,2 union all select 'spread', case when spread is null then 'z ?' when spread<=1 then 'a 1' when spread=2 then 'b 2' else 'c 3+' end, count(*), sum((p.realized_pnl<0)::int) from m join p using (market_ticker) where p.pos=0 group by 1,2 union all select 'fast_x_ahead', case when wait_min<30 and ahead0<=10 then 'a fast+short queue' when wait_min<30 then 'b fast+longer queue' when ahead0<=10 then 'c slow+short queue' else 'd slow+longer queue' end, count(*), sum((p.realized_pnl<0)::int) from m join p using (market_ticker) where p.pos=0 and ahead0 is not null group by 1,2 order by 1,2
